cryptoAside.title: Already have crypto?
cryptoAside.body: Transfer USDC directly with no fees.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Enter an amount and choose how to pay.
howItWorks.step2: Pay your way: Apple Pay, Google Pay, cards, bank transfers, or instant local payments in 80+ countries.
howItWorks.step3: Your USDC lands in your account, ready to invest.

method.title: Payment method
method.allBlocked: Increase your deposit to {amount}. No payment method accepts less right now.
method.loading: Loading the payment methods for this currency
method.unavailable: Paybis did not return any payment options right now. You can continue and choose how to pay in the secure checkout.

review.title: Review
review.belowNeed: You need at least {amount} to fund this investment.
review.ethUnpriced: We couldn't start your purchase because we couldn't get an ETH price just now. Please try again.

success.title: Deposit confirmed
success.subtitle: Your money is ready to invest

crypto.title: Deposit crypto
crypto.waitingTitle: Check back in a few minutes
crypto.waitingBody: We cannot confirm transfers sent from another app or exchange. Your balance updates on its own once the money arrives.
crypto.noWallet: Connect your wallet to see your deposit address.
crypto.networkSubtitle: Send USDC only on the network you pick here. Sending on any other network can permanently lose your funds.
crypto.networkWarning: Send USDC on {network} only. Sending on another network may result in permanent loss.

checkout.approx: You will see a slightly higher amount in the secure checkout. That covers the provider's spread, so about {amount} USDC reaches your wallet.
checkout.approxNoPrefill: Enter the amount you want to pay in the secure checkout. About {amount} USDC will reach your wallet.
checkout.baselineUnavailable: We could not read your wallet balance, so we cannot start a purchase yet. Check your connection and try again.
checkout.belowMinimum: This is below the {amount} minimum to invest. The money is in your wallet, and you can add more whenever you like.
checkout.uncoveredTitle: We cannot sell to you right now
checkout.uncoveredBody: No provider will sell crypto for {currency} at this amount today. Try a different amount, or come back later.
checkout.currencyUnsupportedBody: We cannot take a payment in your currency right now. Try again in a moment, or come back later.
checkout.unverifiedTitle: We could not confirm your payment yet
checkout.unverifiedBody: If you paid, the funds appear in your wallet once the payment settles. You can leave this page; nothing is lost.
checkout.openingBody: Complete your purchase in the secure checkout. Keep this page open.

resume.title: You may have a purchase in progress
resume.body: You started a purchase {minutes} minutes ago. If you paid, the money may still be on its way. Resuming waits for it. Starting again creates a new purchase, so only do that if the first one never went through.
resume.paidBody: You paid {minutes} minutes ago and the money has not arrived yet. This can take a while, especially for a bank transfer. Waiting is usually right. Only start a new purchase if you are sure the first one is never arriving, because that means paying again.

onramp.settlingBody: Your balance will update as soon as the funds settle. This can take a few minutes.
onramp.settledErrorBody: We could not finish converting it to USDC. Your money is safe, resting as ETH on Base. Try again to finish the conversion.
onramp.errorBody: The purchase did not go through and no money was moved. You can try again.
onramp.title: Buy crypto

currency.title: Currency
currency.footnote: Payment methods change with the currency.
